rows.subject: Midnight 12.0.5 PTR Changes Episode 1: The Secret Menace
rows.change: Hello again from Blizzard! With 12.0.5 PTR slated to start today, here is the list of addon API changes you can expect to see in next couple builds, followed by a discussion about some longer-term changes we are considering for the aura system.

rows.subject: Midnight 12.0.5 PTR Changes Episode 1: The Secret Menace
rows.change: DISCLAIMER: These notes are for addon authors and as such are focused specifically on addon security changes only. Changes planned for other parts of the game (UI or otherwise) are not included here.

rows.subject: Midnight 12.0.5 PTR Changes Episode 1: The Secret Menace
rows.change: We have added three new Lua object types for numeric formatting: AbbreviatedNumberFormatter, NumericRuleFormatter, and SecondsFormatter. These types can be supplied with secret numbers through the Format functions on duration objects.

rows.subject: Midnight 12.0.5 PTR Changes Episode 1: The Secret Menace
rows.change: We're considering adjusting the various "display count" APIs (eg. GetSpellDisplayCount) to accept formatter objects, but this would be a breaking change (let us know your thoughts).

rows.subject: Midnight 12.0.5 PTR Changes Episode 1: The Secret Menace
rows.change: The following APIs will now return a zero-span duration object when the queried spell is at maximum charges: GetSpellBookItemChargeDuration, GetSpellChargeDuration, GetActionChargeDuration.

rows.subject: Midnight 12.0.5 PTR Changes Episode 1: The Secret Menace
rows.change: Duration objects that measure a zero-span are now considered fully elapsed.

rows.subject: Midnight 12.0.5 PTR Changes Episode 1: The Secret Menace
rows.change: The isHelpful, isHarmful, isRaid, isNameplateOnly, and isFromPlayerOrPlayerPet booleans on aura data tables are no longer secret.

rows.subject: Midnight 12.0.5 PTR Changes Episode 1: The Secret Menace
rows.change: Added GetTransmogOutfitIndex to the restricted environment. Values returned from this can be used with the new /outfit slash command.

rows.subject: Midnight 12.0.5 PTR Changes Episode 1: The Secret Menace
rows.change: Added a new Predicates table to out Lua API documentation, which will provide a description of the restrictions on each API.

rows.subject: Midnight 12.0.5 PTR Changes Episode 1: The Secret Menace
rows.change: The Ambiguate function now accepts secrets from addons.

rows.subject: Midnight 12.0.5 PTR Changes Episode 1: The Secret Menace
rows.change: Added a Cooldown:SetCountdownMillisecondsThreshold(seconds) API. When a cooldown frame is rendering a time below this number of seconds, it will be displayed as a decimal value with one decimal place (e.g. "8.7").

rows.subject: Midnight 12.0.5 PTR Changes Episode 1: The Secret Menace
rows.change: String formatting APIs no longer honor field width modifiers for secret string values (e.g. the "%.5s" format will no longer truncate a secret string).

rows.subject: Midnight 12.0.5 PTR Changes Episode 1: The Secret Menace
rows.change: The UnitSpellTargetName API now only returns names for player units.

rows.subject: Midnight 12.0.5 PTR Changes Episode 1: The Secret Menace
rows.change: The C_EncounterEvents.GetEventSound API no longer errors when called.

rows.subject: Midnight 12.0.5 PTR Changes Episode 1: The Secret Menace
rows.change: The UnitTokenFromGUID API (and various others) will no longer return arena, nameplate, boss, party, raid, or target-of-target unit tokens when unit identities are secret.

rows.subject: Midnight 12.0.5 PTR Changes Episode 1: The Secret Menace
rows.change: UnitTokenNamePlate APIs will no longer accept party, raid, or target-of-target unit tokens.

rows.subject: Midnight 12.0.5 PTR Changes Episode 1: The Secret Menace
rows.change: Addon execution throttles will no longer apply while the PLAYER_LOGOUT and ADDONS_UNLOADING events are being processed.

rows.subject: Midnight 12.0.5 PTR Changes Episode 1: The Secret Menace
rows.change: While we have a variety of plans for future patches (12.0.7 and beyond), including many more quality-of-life fixes for addon developers, we wanted to take a moment to talk about one area in particular that we are putting a lot of thought into: Auras (particularly of the Private variety).

rows.subject: Midnight 12.0.5 PTR Changes Episode 1: The Secret Menace
rows.change: We created the Private Aura system back in 10.1 as a means to prevent addons from automating certain very specific fight mechanics. In some ways Private Auras can be viewed as the beginning of our experimentation with adjusting addon capabilities, and while they certainly had their issues, for the most part they served their purpose (albeit in a rather heavy-handed way). When we started developing the Secret Value system, we had hoped (planned even) to be able to essentially retire the Private Aura system and replace it with just secrets.

rows.subject: Midnight 12.0.5 PTR Changes Episode 1: The Secret Menace
rows.change: Unfortunately, as Midnight Alpha & Beta progressed it became clear that relying on Secret Values alone was not going to be enough to prevent addon automation involving auras. And so, we ended up having to go in almost the exact opposite direction: we made MOST encounter debuffs private auras rather than just a select few. While this approach gave us the security we needed for Midnight Season 1, it also came with some significant downsides. Our own private aura displays don't currently have full parity with normal auras, and they aren’t supported in nameplates. On top of that they also require our encounter designers to be very diligent about flagging almost every encounter debuff as private, which is cumbersome and very easy to get wrong.

rows.subject: Midnight 12.0.5 PTR Changes Episode 1: The Secret Menace
rows.change: All this is to say that we are not happy with the current state of auras as they pertain to addons, and we are planning to make some large changes to them. We don't have a hard target yet for when this rework will happen, but just to ease your minds a little it definitely will NOT be in 12.0.5 or 12.0.7. What shape this new aura system will take is also nowhere near decided yet so we won't have any specifics for a while yet, but the overarching goals can be summed up as:

rows.subject: Midnight 12.0.5 PTR Changes Episode 1: The Secret Menace
rows.change: Auras need to be more secure than they currently are (with less upkeep for designers).

rows.subject: Midnight 12.0.5 PTR Changes Episode 1: The Secret Menace
rows.change: Auras still need to be customizable and displayable by addons.

rows.subject: Midnight 12.0.5 PTR Changes Episode 1: The Secret Menace
rows.change: And then as a bonus goal we would like auras to be more performant for addons.

rows.subject: Midnight 12.0.5 PTR Changes Episode 1: The Secret Menace
rows.change: We will be consulting with addon developers as we start to plan out work on this new system, so don't worry about this being dropped on you out of the blue. We just wanted to give you an idea of where our heads are at, so it doesn't come as a surprise later.

rows.subject: Midnight 12.0.5 PTR Changes Episode 1: The Secret Menace
rows.change: Oh and just to make Meo happy, Jar Jar would like to say: Wesa will have mooie tings to share berry soon!

rows.subject: Midnight 12.0.5 and Classic PTR Update
rows.change: But first, a quick update about what to expect in regard to addon security in the upcoming Classic 5.5.4 PTR (and all future Classic releases).

rows.subject: Midnight 12.0.5 and Classic PTR Update
rows.change: DISCLAIMER: These notes are for addon authors and as such are focused specifically on addon security changes only. Changes planned for other parts of the game (UI or otherwise) are not included here.

rows.subject: Midnight 12.0.5 and Classic PTR Update
rows.change: By and large, the addon security systems we put in place for Midnight will not be active in Classic. The secret value system is entirely disabled on Classic builds, and any API that returns secrets on Mainline will return non-secrets in Classic.

rows.subject: Midnight 12.0.5 and Classic PTR Update
rows.change: The new chat restrictions will also be inactive in Classic, and combat log events will work just like they do currently in Classic. Additional restrictions to various APIs added in Midnight (guild APIs, etc.) will also not be active in Classic. The existing pre-Midnight security systems (taint, restricted actions, etc.) will still be active of course. Brand new functionality and objects that were added in Midnight (duration objects, curves, etc. and their associated APIs) will be available in Classic.

rows.subject: Midnight 12.0.5 and Classic PTR Update
rows.change: One thing to note here is that Lua API documentation files do currently still reference secret values despite them not actually applying in Classic. We are working on fixing that, as well as doing an overall pass to make sure everything is working as expected in Classic. If you notice specific APIs that appear to not be working as expected please pass those along to us in the feedback channel.

rows.subject: Midnight 12.0.5 and Classic PTR Update
rows.change: Added a new API C_ScenarioInfo.GetUnitCriteriaProgressValues(unitToken) API which returns the M+ Enemy Forces value of the unit as an int (plain value), float (percent) and string (percent). Returns are secret when unit identity is secret.
